role: Abstract base of every tree generator: func_150523_a says which blocks a growing tree may replace (air, leaves, grass, dirt, logs, saplings, vines), and func_150524_b is an empty post-grow hook the mega pine overrides.
scope_reason: Trees generate in decoration and grow from saplings; all overworld decoration is vanilla and in scope.

members.name: WorldGenAbstractTree
members.note: Passes the block-notify flag to WorldGenerator; the C tree writers pick the setBlock flag directly.

members.name: func_150523_a
members.note: Duplicated as a static in csrc/engine/features_trees_small.c.

members.name: func_150524_b
members.note: Empty in the base; place_tree runs the mega pine's override (features_trees.c) after a grow and nothing for the others.

notes: Two copies of tree_replaceable exist (features_trees.c and features_trees_small.c); a GPU port should keep one. Gates not re-run for this record.
